native_findings.contract: Death initializes map 1; Evil Points < 40 select room 2189 and Evil Points >= 40 select room 142. Reputation labels are not consulted by this branch.
A nonzero current-room DeathRoom replaces the default destination and retains the current room map.
The shared leave/death cleanup owner is called before status termination, item/currency disposal, life decrement, respawn/save, or final-death persistence.

When the native arena global is enabled and RoomType == 5, saved arena-entry HP and maximum mana are restored, the already-resolved death destination is applied, and the routine returns before money/items are dropped or a life is decremented.
All five carried currency denomination fields are added to the death room and then zeroed on the player.

A life is decremented; if at least one remains, HP is restored from maximum HP, mana from maximum mana, the resolved destination is assigned, and the player is moved/saved immediately. No manual respawn command is required.
When final-reroll KEEP conditions apply and level > 1, permanent-info XP becomes max(stock threshold for floor(level/2)+1, floor(total XP/10)); otherwise the retained value is zero.
Permanent-info field +0x48 is copied directly into the new player's XP field +0x3C.
Character creation calls _update_user_with_permanent_info once after core new-player field initialization.

Room disposal uses bounded depth-first exit traversal in native slot order, skips RoomType 12 and 8, and falls back to the player's 20-entry movement trail. Exact room-slot stacking/add-item behavior is not yet fully connected in Reforged, so the floor-spill assertion remains STRONG.

stock_room_correlation.name: Arena Practice Room
stock_room_correlation.note: The executable + stock room record therefore revive a defeated player to room 205 when the arena exception is enabled. Retained HELP text that says Halls Of The Dead is preserved as a source conflict and does not override executable behavior.
